headline: Fund Investigations: Statements from Justice Minister Akın Gürlek and the Capital Markets Board (SPK)
summary: Justice Minister Akın Gürlek said compensating twice the amount of a loss is grounds for effective remorse but does not stop legal proceedings against the individual, amid fund investigations.
why: Regulatory and legal action in fund markets affects investor confidence and oversight of Türkiye's capital markets.
